rounds.ai_message: Emma, Tom from Sunrise. I see your tech pack for the 240 GSM compact yarn pique with Lycra for the polo line. I have a quick question before I commit a development slot — what's the polo fabric stability you're targeting? I'm asking because 240 GSM pique is on the heavy side for polo, and we want to make sure it's not over-engineered.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Emma,Sunrise 的 Tom。我看了你们 polo 线那条 240 GSM 紧密纺珠地 + 莱卡的工艺单。我报开发前有个问题:polo 面料的稳定性要多少?我这么问是因为 240 GSM 珠地 polo 偏重,我们想确认不是 over-engineered。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 解释目标(重磅 polo 耐用/挺括 vs 轻量 polo 透气),让对方给开发建议
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I am not sure' — engage: 'We want a substantial hand and recovery. 240 is intentional. What's the GSM of your reference polo?'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶:对方 probe 你规格是否合理,要正面回应而不是退缩

rounds.ai_message: Good — 240 is intentional. Let me check my reference: we did 220 GSM compact pique with 3% Lycra for a similar program. The shrinkage was 4% warp, 2% weft. For your 240, I would expect similar, maybe 4.5% warp. The challenge is the GSM window — going to 240 makes the fabric feel boardy if we are not careful with the yarn count. What yarn count are you specifying?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好 — 240 是有意为之。我查一下:我之前给类似项目做过 220 GSM 紧密纺珠地 + 3% 莱卡。缩水 4% 经向、2% 纬向。您 240 GSM 的话,我预估差不多,可能经向 4.5%。难点是克重窗口 — 到 240 的话,如果支数选不好,面料会偏硬板。您指定的是哪个纱支?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 报 32s 精梳棉 + 20D 莱卡;或问 26s 还是 32s 哪个更合适
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'you decide' — say 'We are at 32s compact, will that keep the hand soft? Or do you recommend 26s for that weight?'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶:让对方参与决策,显得 team work

rounds.ai_message: For 240 GSM, I'd recommend 26s compact rather than 32s. 32s would make the fabric too tight, you lose the breathing room. 26s gives the right balance — heavy enough to feel substantial, but the yarn still has room to relax. We will run a 24-cut Mayer, 30 inch, 78 feeders. Want me to send two hand samples — one in 26s, one in 32s — for your comparison?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 240 GSM 的话,我推荐 26 支紧密纺,不要 32 支。32 支会让面料太紧,失去透气感。26 支给到刚好的平衡 — 重到有质感,但纱还有松量可以做呼吸感。我们用 24 针 Mayer、30 寸、78 路做。要不要我发两块手样 — 一块 26 支,一块 32 支,给你比较?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受两块手样,接受 26 支推荐
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'just 26' — say 'Send both. We will pick after hand feel and lab test.'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶:接受 AB 对比是聪明的客户

rounds.ai_message: On the knitting construction — for a true Lacoste pique, we need the knit-tuck-miss pattern repeat. The cam arrangement is a 6-step repeat. Course count: 18 per cm, wale count: 14 per cm. PCM (pique construction) is achieved with the tuck stitches. We can also do a mini-pique for lighter weight.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 织造结构 — 真珠地(类似 Lacoste polo)需要 knit-tuck-miss 循环。三角排列是 6 步循环。横密 18 行/厘米,纵密 14 列/厘米。PCM 珠地结构靠 tuck 线圈实现。轻量版可以做 mini-pique。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 选 Lacoste 经典珠地(knit-tuck-miss 6 步循环),问 mini-pique 与 经典珠地差异
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'any pattern is fine' — engage: 'Standard Lacoste 6-step. Confirm the tuck height — we want 1.5 mm.'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶:经典珠地有特定三角排列,显专业

rounds.ai_message: On the finishing — for compact yarn pique, the pre-shrinking and compacting sequence matters. We use a 3-step process: relax dryer, compact, then calendar. Compact 200 degrees C, line speed 15 m/min, overfeed 30%. Calendar is for surface finishing only. Color fastness wash 4, light 4, rubbing 4 dry / 3 wet. Lab dip in 5 days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 后整理 — 紧密纺珠地,预缩和压光的工序顺序很关键。我们用 3 步:松弛烘干 → 预缩机 → 压光。预缩 200 度,线速 15 米/分,超喂 30%。压光只做表面处理。色牢度水洗 4 级,日晒 4 级,摩擦 4 干 / 3 湿。lab dip 5 天。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 3 步工艺可以,问 calendar 温度/压力(影响手感),问绒感
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'sounds good' — '3-step finishing is fine. What's the calendar temp and pressure? We want a soft hand, not pressed.'
rounds.tips_zh: 高阶:对 calender 工艺要 detail

rounds.ai_message: All right. Here is the deal — I will send you two hand samples (26s and 32s) in 4 days, greige only, plus a 1-meter lab dip in 5 days. Once you approve, I commit a 50-meter trial in 14 days, then bulk. Bulk 30 days from trial approval. 220 — sorry, 240 GSM. Right?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。这样 — 我 4 天内给您两块手样(26 支和 32 支),只有坯布,加 1 米 lab dip 5 天。确认后我留 50 米试产 14 天,然后大货。大货试产确认后 30 天。220 — 抱歉,240 GSM。对吧?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 240 GSM 没错;承诺发 Pantone
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'ok' alone — '240 GSM, yes. Will send 2 Pantone codes today. Looking forward to the hand samples.'
rounds.tips_zh: 收尾:确认数字 + 下一步
